# TRAM source notice

BeyondRetarget Plus adapts components from [TRAM: Global Trajectory and
Motion of 3D Humans from in-the-wild Videos](https://github.com/yufu-wang/tram).

The adapted source is distributed under the upstream MIT license. See
[`LICENSE`](LICENSE) in this directory and the repository-level
[`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`](../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) for attribution and
dependency notices.

The runnable BeyondRetarget Plus commands are documented in the repository
root [`README.md`](../../README.md). The original TRAM demo and training
instructions are intentionally not duplicated here because this checkout uses
the Plus data contracts, configurations, and entry points.
